audience.text: Java developers building server-side or desktop applications that require PDF document generation, manipulation, and conversion without third-party runtime dependencies.

capabilities.text: Build pages from scratch using Page, Paragraphs, Table, Row, Cell, FloatingBox, HeaderFooter, and stamps (TextStamp, ImageStamp, PageNumberStamp).
capabilities.title: Create and edit PDF content

capabilities.text: Locate, extract, and replace text using TextFragmentAbsorber and TextAbsorber, including right-to-left and Arabic glyph shaping via ArabicShaper.
capabilities.title: Text extraction and manipulation

capabilities.text: Work with AcroForm fields (TextBoxField, CheckboxField, ComboBoxField, etc.) and XFA forms via Form, XfaForm, XfaAcroFormConverter, and XfaFlattener.
capabilities.title: Form handling

capabilities.text: Add and read annotations including highlight, underline, strikeout, squiggly, free text, ink, stamps, file attachments, links, and redaction.
capabilities.title: Annotations and markup

capabilities.text: Encrypt and decrypt documents with AES or RC4 using AESCipher, RC4Cipher, and StandardSecurityHandler with separate user and owner passwords.
capabilities.title: Security and encryption

capabilities.text: Split, merge, insert, extract, and reorder pages using PdfFileEditor, and edit individual page size and rotation with PdfPageEditor.
capabilities.title: Page operations

capabilities.text: Validate and convert documents to PDF/A-1 through PDF/A-4 using PdfAValidator, PdfAConverter, and PdfAValidationResult.
capabilities.title: PDF/A and validation

capabilities.text: Import HTML into PDF using HtmlLoadOptions and HtmlToPdfConverter, and export PDF to HTML or XML using HtmlSaveOptions and PdfToHtmlConverter.
capabilities.title: HTML import and export

limitations.text: OCR functionality is not included; use a dedicated OCR library for text recognition in scanned images.
Conversion to non-PDF formats (DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, EPUB, etc.) and from non-PDF formats (DOC, XPS, PostScript, SVG, etc.) is not supported.
Full XFA form rendering is not reproduced; XFA data can be flattened to AcroForm but dynamic layout is not rendered.
PdfFileSecurity.setAllowExceptions throws UnsupportedOperationException; the legacy AllowExceptions=false path is not implemented.
Text replacement with non-Latin scripts (CJK, Arabic, Hebrew) may differ from a reference renderer in complex bidi cases.
A single Document instance is not thread-safe; use one Document per thread for parallel processing.

problems_solved.text: Enables creation and editing of PDF documents using a pure Java API without external native dependencies or runtime libraries.
Supports text extraction, replacement, and search—including right-to-left and Arabic glyph shaping—via TextFragmentAbsorber and TextAbsorber.
Provides tools for form handling (AcroForm and XFA), annotations, digital signatures, encryption, and PDF/A validation/conversion.
Offers page operations (split, merge, reorder), rendering to raster images, and HTML import/export—all within a single dependency.

product_summary.text: Aspose.PDF FOSS for Java is a free, open-source, pure-Java library for creating, reading, and modifying PDF documents compliant with ISO 32000-1:2008.

uncertainties: The exact set of public symbols beyond org.aspose.pdf is not fully enumerated in the facts.
Whether QR code generation via QrEncoder is fully ISO/IEC 18004 compliant beyond Model 2 is not confirmed by facts.
The extent of PDF/X validation and conversion test coverage is not detailed beyond 'no dedicated test coverage yet'.
The behavior of Image.setSelectedFrame(int) for multi-frame TIFF import is described but not verified by code examples.
Whether all public symbols listed in the README are present in the published artifact is not confirmed by facts.
The exact behavior of Document.optimizeResources() for font merging across resources is not specified beyond 'limited'.
The thread-safety boundary for Document instances is stated but not tested or demonstrated in code.
The version of Maven required to build the project is not explicitly stated beyond 'Maven 3'.

workflows.name: Create and save a PDF from scratch
workflows.text: Instantiate a Document, add a Page, insert Paragraphs including tables or stamps, and save to disk using Document.save.

workflows.name: Extract text from an existing PDF
workflows.text: Create a TextAbsorber, call Page.accept(TextAbsorber), and retrieve extracted text via TextAbsorber.getText.

workflows.name: Edit form fields in a PDF
workflows.text: Access Form via Document.getForm, retrieve or update Field values, and add new fields such as TextBoxField or CheckboxField.

workflows.name: Render PDF pages to images
workflows.text: Use a PageDevice subclass (e.g., PngDevice) and call process(Page, OutputStream) to generate raster images.

workflows.name: Sign or verify a PDF
workflows.text: Use PdfSigner with PKCS7 or PKCS7Detached to sign; use SignatureVerificationResult to verify existing signatures.

workflows.name: Optimize a PDF's file size
workflows.text: Call Document.optimizeResources(OptimizationOptions) to remove unused objects, link duplicate streams, and recompress content.
